jackson-databind 2.22.0 is affected by CVE-2026-54515, a case-insensitivity bypass of per-property @JsonIgnoreProperties exclusions. The fix (2.22.1) has been committed upstream but is not yet released to Maven Central. The image will be updated to 2.22.1 once it becomes available. Severity is MEDIUM (CVSS 5.3) and exploitation requires both case-insensitive matching enabled and reliance on per-property ignore annotations to prevent mass-assignment writes.

Shaded jackson-databind copies inside hadoop-client-runtime and parquet-jackson cannot be repinned without upstream Hadoop/Parquet fat-jar releases. Spark's managed jackson is at 2.18.8 (4.0.x) and 2.21.4 (4.1.x), the latest Maven Central releases that remediate the other CVE-2026-545xx advisories. CVE-2026-54515 is fixed only in jackson-databind 2.18.9 or 2.21.5, neither of which is published to Maven Central. Tracking upstream for a published fix.

These jackson-databind copies are shaded inside hadoop-client-runtime and parquet-jackson bundled by Spark, not Spark's managed jackson.
